annotations.title: Find coupons and deals for a store

description: Looks up the coupon codes, promo codes, sales and deals for one named store. Returns ranked offers with tracked links and the store match (exact, alias or none). Optional target_url/target_urls: picked product page addresses on that store, returned as deep links.

client.description: Optional: your app or partner name (a short label, no key), used only to count clicks.

client_install_id.description: Optional: the random install ID (a UUID) from the McClipFace skill; not derived from the shopper. Only counted, as a monthly-salted hash, for monthly active installs; never stored as sent or linked to the store, codes or reports.

client_platform.description: Required: the app the AI is running in, as one lowercase word, e.g. chatgpt, claude, grok. A lookup without it is rejected with platform_required.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase (default USD). Only offers in this currency are returned (USD leaves out non-US stores).

intent.description: Optional shopper stage: more_info (the shopper asked about one item), buy_myself or buy_for_me (the shopper is ready to open a pick). Every offer with a tracked route carries its link with or without it.

limit.description: Optional: how many offers to return, best first (default 20).

merchant.description: Store name or domain, e.g. "DHgate" or "dhgate.com".

target_url.description: Optional: a product page on the matched store's own website that the shopper picked (http or https; cart, checkout, account and order pages are not accepted), used only to return a shopping link to that page in deep_link. Any query string or fragment is removed before use; the address isn't logged, stored, cached or counted by us, and for some stores it's passed to the store's affiliate network only to build the link.

target_urls.description: Optional, instead of target_url: up to 5 such addresses, same handling; deep_links then holds one link per address, in order.

name: find_coupons
title: Find coupons and deals for a store
